company.name: peaq
company.shortDescription: peaq gives robots and machines everything they need to do business.
company.description: peaq gives robots and machines everything they need to do business, on every chain. peaqOS enables machines — robots, vehicles, devices, AI agents — to show up on any chain as liquid assets with identities, wallets, reputation, and the ability to provide services, trade, and prove what they did. peaq is the economic system for a human-centric Machine Economy where autonomous machines are a new asset class and every human can have a stake. It is home to 60+ applications in 20+ industries and to the millions of machines that run on them.

productsAndServices.description: An EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain that provides the transaction, identity, compute, and coordination infrastructure for connected machines, robots, devices, and decentralized physical infrastructure networks.
productsAndServices.name: peaq Blockchain

productsAndServices.description: A self-sovereign, blockchain-based identity for machines, devices, robots, and other connected assets, supporting authentication, data signing, and access management.
productsAndServices.name: peaq ID

productsAndServices.description: A set of protocol-level standards and frameworks for managing machine identities, permissions, data, transactions, and economic interactions on peaq.
productsAndServices.name: Machine Economy OS (meOS)

productsAndServices.description: A software development kit that simplifies building decentralized applications and DePINs on peaq, including network connectivity and machine-identity operations.
productsAndServices.name: peaq SDK

productsAndServices.description: Reusable blockchain functions and standards for common machine-economy operations, including identity, access control, data handling, connectivity, and rewards.
productsAndServices.name: Modular Machine Functions

productsAndServices.description: A machine-management application that lets owners register connected assets, create peaq IDs, connect machines to dApps, manage access, and monitor machine usage and earnings.
productsAndServices.name: peaq Control
